notice: Item IDs and titles are from the OWASP MCP Top 10 project. Coverage levels, reasons and detector mappings are Axiom's own assessment and are not endorsed by OWASP.

items.title: Token Mismanagement & Secret Exposure
items.reason: Regex-based secret detection in server source and client configs plus env-var exposure checks; no entropy analysis, git-history scan, or token lifetime/passthrough checks.

items.title: Privilege Escalation via Scope Creep
items.reason: Permission over-scope patterns, toxic tool-capability combinations, path-escape checks and env-var over-exposure in configs.

items.title: Tool Poisoning
items.reason: Dedicated detector for hidden instructions in tool metadata, plus runtime rug-pull diffing between source and live tool definitions.

items.title: Software Supply Chain Attacks & Dependency Tampering
items.reason: Dependency CVE lookup, known MCP CVEs, install lifecycle hooks, and unpinned npx/uvx/pip/@latest install sources.

items.title: Command Injection & Execution
items.reason: Regex, AST and Semgrep find exec/shell sinks and a heuristic flags sinks inside tool handlers, but there is no inter-procedural taint tracking from tool input to sink.

items.title: Prompt Injection via Contextual Payloads
items.reason: Injection markers are detected in tool metadata, server instructions, resources, prompts and the strings a tool returns (static), and in instructions/resources/prompts read live; payloads produced by calling a tool at runtime are not inspected.

items.title: Insufficient Authentication & Authorization
items.reason: Flags remote servers with no visible auth and servers bound to all interfaces; does not verify OAuth implementation or per-tool authorization logic.

items.title: Lack of Audit and Telemetry
items.reason: Only a low-confidence heuristic for missing logging in tool-defining files; actual audit trails and telemetry pipelines are not verified.

items.title: Shadow MCP Servers
items.reason: Covered by `axiom discover` allowlist on the local machine; no network-wide or fleet discovery.

items.title: Context Injection & Over-Sharing
items.reason: Hard-coded egress URLs, tools that send to caller-chosen destinations and bulk-exposure heuristics are detected statically and live; what context is actually shared at runtime is not observed.
